title: On Golod Subdeterminantal Ideals
summary: Let $X=(x_{ij})_{m\times n}$ be a matrix of indeterminates and let $S=\mathbb{k}[x_{ij} \mid 1\leq i\leq m,\ 1\leq j\leq n]$ be a polynomial ring over an infinite field $\mathbb{k}$. Let $I$ be an ideal generated by a subset of the set of all $2\times2$ minors of $X$. We show that the quotient ring $S/I$ is Golod if and only if $I=I_2(Y)$ for some $2\times \ell$ or $\ell\times2$ submatrix $Y$ of $X$. In fact, we prove that Golodness of $S/I$ is equivalent to the triviality of the product on the Koszul homology of $S/I$ and to $I$ having a linear resolution. Along the way, we also prove a…
